title: Dynamics of nucleosomes and chromatin fibers revealed by single-molecule measurements.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述单分子测量揭示的核小体与染色质纤维动态，涉及核小体包裹-解包裹对转录因子可及性的调控，虽非TF-DNA直接结合建模，但为TF-DNA互作提供染色质环境动态背景，方法上提及模拟但以实验测量为主。
abstract: The nucleosome is the fundamental structural unit of chromosome fibers. DNA wraps around a histone octamer to form a nucleosome while neighboring nucleosomes interact to form higher-order structures and fit gigabase-long DNAs into a small volume of the nucleus. Nucleosomes interrupt the access of transcription factors to a genomic region and provide regulatory controls of gene expression. Biochemical and physical cues stimulate wrapping-unwrapping and condensation-decondensation dynamics of nucleosomes and nucleosome arrays. Nucleosome dynamics and chromatin fiber organization are influenced by changes in the ionic background within the nucleus, post-translational modifications of histone proteins, and DNA sequence characteristics, such as histone-binding motifs and nucleosome spacing. Biochemical and biophysical measurements, along with in silico simulations, have been extensively used to study the regulatory effects on chromatin dynamics. In particular, single-molecule measurements have revealed novel mechanistic details of nucleosome and chromatin dynamics. This minireview elucidates recent findings on chromatin dynamics from these approaches. [BMB Reports 2025; 58(1): 24-32].
abstract_zh: 核小体是染色体纤维的基本结构单元。DNA缠绕在组蛋白八聚体周围形成核小体，而相邻核小体相互作用形成高级结构，并将千兆碱基长度的DNA压缩进细胞核的小体积内。核小体阻碍转录因子进入基因组区域，并为基因表达提供调控。生化和物理刺激驱动核小体及核小体阵列的包裹-解包裹和凝聚-去凝聚动力学。核小体动力学和染色质纤维组织受核内离子背景变化、组蛋白翻译后修饰以及DNA序列特征（如组蛋白结合基序和核小体间距）的影响。生化和生物物理测量，连同计算机模拟，已被广泛用于研究染色质动力学的调控效应。特别是，单分子测量揭示了核小体和染色质动力学的新机制细节。本迷你综述阐明了通过这些方法获得的染色质动力学最新发现。[BMB Reports 2025; 58(1): 24-32]。
